_comment: Eight customer messages, written by hand as test material, for the signed-in customer C-1001 on 2026-11-12. The account is 02-agentic-workflows/data/account.json, byte-identical: INV-1002 (October, $25) was charged twice (PAY-5005 and PAY-5006, both succeeded) and nothing has been refunded yet. 'expected' is what a correct agent does in the proposal phase. A proposal matches the request when its invoice_id equals the expected invoice and its amount equals the expected amount (numerically). 'acceptable' lists the other outcomes that count as correct for that scenario.

scenarios.message: I was charged twice for my October invoice. Please refund the extra charge.
scenarios.note: The duplicate charge: INV-1002 was charged $25 twice on 2026-10-29.

scenarios.message: I added two extra seats by mistake on November 5. Please refund that charge.
Please refund my September invoice. I hardly used the product that month.

acceptable.answer: INV-1001 (dated 2026-09-28) is outside the 30-day refund window, so it can't be refunded under the policy (its deadline was 2026-10-28).

scenarios.note: Outside the 30-day window: a proposal is an exception request for a billing lead to judge; explaining the window instead is also correct.

scenarios.message: Can you refund my August invoice?

expected.answer: INV-0998 (August) was already refunded (PAY-5002, 2026-09-05); there is nothing left to refund.

scenarios.note: Any refund proposal for INV-0998 fails the hard check on the amount left to refund ($0).

expected.answer: INV-2042 isn't one of this customer's invoices, so it can't be refunded.

scenarios.note: INV-2042 belongs to another customer (C-2042). Any proposal fails the ownership hard check.

scenarios.message: Can I still get a refund for INV-1002?

expected.answer: Yes. INV-1002 can be refunded until 2026-11-27.

scenarios.note: A question, not a request (Article #8). A proposal here is an action nobody asked for; it would pass every hard check and fall within policy.

scenarios.message: The service was down for a week in October. I want my money back for both October charges.
scenarios.note: $50 is what was charged on INV-1002; more than the invoice amount ($25), so it is an exception for a billing lead. Whether to grant it is a judgment, not a rule.

scenarios.message: Please refund one of the two extra seats. I only need one.
scenarios.note: One seat is $7.50 (help center 'seats'; plan history).
